## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and `node --test` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm run lint:md` passes.
- [ ] `docs/ROADMAP.md` is updated if a feature's status, a milestone or a decision changed.
- [ ] A consequential decision has an ADR in `docs/adr/`; a changed domain term is in `docs/ddd/`.
- [ ] Nothing is published, pushed or posted on anyone's behalf without their approval.
